ram-boot.note: USB RAM loading reaches the authenticated Linux session in the default profile. Physical keypad use is unqualified.

persistent-boot.note: Every start requires the PC's USB loader.

local-console.note: Visible terminal output in RAM. Orientation, color accuracy and physical keypad input are unqualified.

lcd-backlight.note: The display is illuminated and the brightness service responds. Visible brightness changes and calibration are unqualified.

keypad-backlight.note: Keypad illumination is visible. Software on/off transitions and automatic timing are unqualified.

usb-networking.note: USB-NCM works in the default RAM and microSD system-card profiles.

ssh-access.note: Authenticated SSH works over the local USB connection in the default RAM and microSD system-card profiles.

file-transfer.note: USB upload and download work with RAM, FAT32 and ext4 data-card files in the RAM profile.

cpu-clock-reporting.note: The selected 768 MHz and 1 GHz frequencies can be read back in the microSD profile.

manual-cpu-frequency-selection.note: Selection between 768 MHz and 1 GHz in the microSD profile changes the observed execution speed; 1 GHz is the default. Voltage and sustained-load behavior are unqualified.

ap-dmaengine.note: The rotation DMA route works in the microSD system-card profile. Other DMA routes are unqualified.

image-rotation-engine.note: Hardware NV16 rotation by 90° works in the microSD system-card profile. Other formats and concurrent use are unqualified.

jpeg-engine.note: Native 240×320 JPEG encode/decode work in RAM and microSD system-card profiles. Scaling a rotated 320×240 frame to 160×120 works with a microSD system root; other sizes and concurrent use are unqualified.

image-rotation.note: NV16 rotation from 240×320 to 320×240 matches the CPU result in the microSD system-card profile. Other formats and concurrent use are unqualified.

jpeg-codec-and-scaling.note: 240×320 encode/decode work in RAM and microSD system-card profiles; scaling supports the tested rotated 320×240 input. Native 240×320 input is not accepted by the scaler.

removable-storage.note: FAT32 and ext4 file reads and writes work in the RAM profile. Insert before boot and keep installed while powered; no hot-swap.

removable-system-root.note: Kernel and ext4 system root load from a prepared microSD card through the USB bootstrap. File changes persist across power cycles. Keep the card installed and remount the root read-only before removing power.

internal-phone-storage.note: Read-only raw NAND backup and device-data preparation work. No mounting, writing or restoration.

headphone-audio.note: An inserted plug is detected and the wired output produces playback in RAM. Channel separation, accessory compatibility and plug insertion/removal are unqualified.

speaker-audio.note: The ALSA card is available; audible speaker playback is unqualified.

phone-microphone.note: Internal capture produces PCM in the RAM profile. Speech quality, sensitivity and acoustic isolation are unqualified.

bluetooth.note: The CM4 controller powers on and discovers devices in the microSD system-card profile. Pairing, connections and additional profiles are unqualified.

wi-fi.note: No supported FPLinux path has been established; physical hardware presence is unknown.

camera.note: BF30A2; 240×320 NV16 capture through V4L2 in the RAM and microSD system-card profiles. Stop and restart work in RAM. Concurrent image jobs, controls and image quality are unqualified.

soc-temperature.note: Temperature readings are available in RAM and microSD profiles and resume after RTC sleep. Physical accuracy is unqualified.

real-time-clock.note: Clock initialization and a five-second alarm with s2idle resume work under USB power with a read-only microSD system root. Accuracy and battery-backed retention are unqualified.

vibration.note: No force-feedback device is enabled. Physical vibration hardware is unqualified.

power-off.note: Battery-only power-off and the physical power-key action are unqualified.

suspend.note: s2idle resumes with an RTC alarm under USB power and a read-only microSD system root. Deep suspend, battery operation and other wake sources are unqualified.

fplinux-armada.note: No force-feedback device is enabled for this target.

brightness-control.note: The brightness service responds; application use, physical keypad control and visible changes are unqualified.

tyrquake.note: Shareware demo playback with a microSD system root; the 320×256 render is downscaled to the 128×160 display. Physical game controls and full gameplay are unqualified; there is no game sound.

built-in-microphone.note: Internal capture produces PCM in the RAM profile. Speech quality, sensitivity and acoustic isolation are unqualified.

automatic-audio-routing.note: The jack service runs with an inserted plug. Plug insertion/removal and automatic output switching are unqualified.
